title: Permitted heights.
officialText:
Fences are permitted to be erected to a maximum height of 10 feet (3048 mm) above the ground.
Exceptions:
1. In residence districts, as established by the New York City Zoning Resolution, fences are permitted to be erected to a
maximum height of 6 feet (1829 mm) above the ground.
2. Fences in residence districts used in conjunction with nonresidence buildings and public playgrounds, excluding buildings
accessory to dwellings, are permitted to be erected to a maximum height of 15 feet (4572 mm) above the ground.
3. Higher fences may be permitted by the commissioner where required for the enclosure of public playgrounds, school yards,
parks, and similar public facilities.
*SECTION BC 3113
SMALL WIND TURBINES
*Section 3113 was added by Local Law 105 of 2018. This law has an effective date of November 25, 2018.
*3113.1 General. In addition to other applicable requirements in this code, other law or rules, and established by the commissioner,
small wind turbines shall be designed and constructed in accordance with this section.
*Section 3113.1 was added by Local Law 105 of 2018. This law has an effective date of November 25, 2018.
*3113.2 Definitions. The following words and terms shall for the purposes of this section have the meanings shown herein.
SMALL WIND TURBINE. A turbine with a swept area smaller than 200 m2 that generates a voltage below 1000 V (AC) or 1500 V
DC).
SMALL WIND TURBINE TOWER. A structure that supports a small wind turbine.
*Section 3113.2 was added by Local Law 105 of 2018. This law has an effective date of November 25, 2018.
*3113.3 Design standards. A small wind turbine shall be designed in accordance with standards adopted by rules of the commissioner.
Such standards shall include but need not be limited to standards relating to the design of small wind turbines that are developed by the
American Wind Energy Association, the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority, the California Energy
Association, the Small Wind Certification Council, the British Wind Energy Association, the International Electrotechnical
Commission, the National Renewable Energy Laboratory, or the Underwriters Laboratory.
*Section 3113.3 was added by Local Law 105 of 2018. This law has an effective date of November 25, 2018.
*3113.4 Wind speed. A small wind turbine shall be designed to withstand winds of up to and including 130 mph (58.1 m/s) or such
higher wind load as may be specified in this code or the design standard for such turbine pursuant to Section 3113.3.
*Section 3113.4 was added by Local Law 105 of 2018. This law has an effective date of November 25, 2018.
*3113.5 Brakes and locks. Where deemed necessary by the commissioner, a small wind turbine shall be equipped with a redundant
braking system and a passive lock, including aerodynamic overspeed controls and mechanical brakes.
*Section 3113.5 was added by Local Law 105 of 2018. This law has an effective date of November 25, 2018.
*3113.5.1 Locking before hurricane or strong wind conditions. If a hurricane or strong wind conditions are expected, the
commissioner may order that small wind turbines equipped with passive locks be stopped and locked.
*Section 3113.5.1 was added by Local Law 105 of 2018. This law has an effective date of November 25, 2018.
*3113.6 Visual appearance. A small wind turbine shall be white, off-white, grey, or another non-obtrusive color specified by the
commissioner.
*Section 3113.6 was added by Local Law 105 of 2018. This law has an effective date of November 25, 2018.
*3113.7 Lighting. A small wind turbine shall not be artificially lighted.
Exception: Lighting that is required by this code or other applicable laws or rules, provided that such lighting is shielded in
accordance with rules promulgated by the commissioner.
*Section 3113.7 was added by Local Law 105 of 2018. This law has an effective date of November 25, 2018.
*3113.8 Access. Access to a small wind turbine shall be limited as follows:
1. Access to electrical components of a small wind turbine shall be prevented by a lock.
2. A small wind turbine tower shall not be climbable, except by authorized personnel, up to a height of 10 feet (3048 mm)
measured from the base of such tower.
*Section 3113.8 was added by Local Law 105 of 2018. This law has an effective date of November 25, 2018.
*3113.9 Noise. A small wind turbine shall be designed in accordance with applicable sections of the New York city noise control code.
*Section 3113.9 was added by Local Law 105 of 2018. This law has an effective date of November 25, 2018.
*3113.10 Shadow flicker. The commissioner shall by rule establish shadow flicker limitations for small wind turbines for the purpose
of limiting, to the extent practicable, such flicker on buildings adjacent to such turbines.
*Section 3113.10 was added by Local Law 105 of 2018. This law has an effective date of November 25, 2018.
*3113.11 Signal interference. The commissioner shall establish rules governing small wind turbines for purpose of minimizing, to the
extent practicable, interference by such turbines with radio, telephone, television, cellular or other similar signals.
*Section 3113.11 was added by Local Law 105 of 2018. This law has an effective date of November 25, 2018.
*3113.12 Setback. No part of a small wind turbine or small wind turbine tower shall be located within a horizontal distance of a
property line that is equal or less than one-half the height of such turbine, including such tower, measured from the base of such tower
or, if there is no such tower, the base of such turbine.
Exception: Turbines or towers for which each owner of property adjacent to such property line has entered into a written
agreement providing that such turbine or tower or a part thereof may be located closer to such property line than this section
allows.
*Section 3113.12 was added by Local Law 105 of 2018. This law has an effective date of November 25, 2018.
*SECTION BC 3114

*3114.5 Brakes and locks. Where necessary for public safety, the commissioner may require that a large wind turbine shall be

*Section 3114.5 was added by Local Law 98 of 2019. This law has an effective date of November 15, 2019.
